title: add NVTX ranges, counters, and microbench instrumentation for runtime profiling
author: Arielle Gomez
description: Motivation: instrument the serving runtime with lightweight NVTX ranges, counters, and a small microbenchmark harness to provide actionable perf signals for kernel selection, KV cache effectiveness, and continuous-batching behavior. This PR introduces runtime NVTX ranges around major phases (request deserialize, tokenize, kv-cache lookup, attention forward, kernel dispatch, kv-cache write, response serialization), adds atomic counters for dropped/served tokens and batching statistics, and a microbench harness that runs short experiments across sequence lengths, batch sizes, and model variants. The goal is to enable: 1) easy correlation of GPU timelines (nsight) with Prometheus metrics and perf dashboards, 2) a reproducible microbench that CI/nightly can run to detect regressions, and 3) low-overhead instrumentation that is opt-in at runtime via REDWOOD_PROF env var (default off). What changed: - runtime/src/infer/instrumentation.rs: new NVTX scoped ranges and lightweight RAII helpers plus a central registry for named counters exposed via /metrics. - runtime/src/serve/batching.rs: added batch lifecycle NVTX ranges and counters for batch sizes + continuous-batching simulator hooks. - runtime/src/kv_cache/cache.rs: added KV cache hit/miss counters and NVTX ranges for lookup/write. - runtime/bench/microbench.rs: new microbench harness and configs for sequence lengths [64,128,512], batch sizes [1,4,8,16], and synthetic/real workload modes. - tools/perf/collect_nvtx.py: small helper to collect nvtx ranges from nsight outputs and correlate with microbench results. - observability/dashboards/runtime_perf.json: Grafana dashboard panels for NVTX-correlated metrics and microbench trend graphs. - docs/perf/README.md: usage, config knobs, and example workflows for debugging regressions. - ci/jenkins/pipelines/nightly-microbench.yaml: nightly job to run microbench and upload metrics/artifacts. - tests/microbench/bench_configs/sample.yaml: sample config used in CI. Checklist: - [x] NVTX ranges implemented and guarded by REDWOOD_PROF - [x] Counters added and exported to Prometheus metrics path - [x] Microbench harness + sample configs - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON for visibility - [x] Nightly CI pipeline added - [x] Basic unit tests for instrumentation helpers Backwards compatibility: instrumentation is disabled by default and guarded; there are no functional changes to inference logic. Follow-ups: - wire microbench output into perf-canary job and alert on regressions (ENG-4299) - add more kernel-level timers (cuBLAS/cuDNN) behind feature flags - add a lightweight on-host sample collector to upload nvtx artifacts to S3 for long term storage

Arielle Gomez: moved increments behind fast-path check and use relaxed atomics; added a small per-thread buffer flush for high-throughput paths.

release_notes: Added optional runtime profiling instrumentation: NVTX ranges, counters, and a microbenchmark harness to help diagnose kernel, scheduling, and KV cache performance. Instrumentation is disabled by default and gated by REDWOOD_PROF. Includes Grafana dashboard and nightly microbench CI job.
